2 (a) In one hour, hand H rotates clockwise from one number to the next number.
For example, from 1.00 am to 2.00 am hand H rotates from 1 to 2.
Show that hand H rotates 0.5° in one minute.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
In one hour, hand M rotates through a full circle.
Show that hand M rotates 6° in one minute.
